item.title: Rússia ataca trem na fronteira entre Ucrânia e Polônia logo após passagem de "trem diplomático"
item.description: Um drone russo atingiu um trem de passageiros na fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia, membro da aliança militar ocidental Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), neste domingo, logo após o ex-primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido Boris Johnson e outros diplomatas europeus terem utilizado a mesma linha.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um drone russo atingiu um trem de passageiros na fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia, membro da aliança militar ocidental Organização do Tratado do Atlântico Norte (Otan), neste domingo, logo após o ex-primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido Boris Johnson e outros diplomatas europeus terem utilizado a mesma linha. O trem, que circulava por uma rota frequentemente utilizada por delegações estrangeiras que retornam de Kiev, foi atacado a apenas 2 quilômetros da fronteira com a Polônia, informou a operadora ferroviária ucraniana. Não houve relatos de vítimas. “Não era o nosso trem, mas aquele que passava poucos minutos depois de nós, perto da passagem de fronteira. Ele foi esvaziado quando o drone se aproximou e ninguém ficou ferido”, disse Carl Bildt, ex-primeiro-ministro da Suécia, no X. Ele e outros políticos estavam voltando para a Europa de trem após participarem de uma conferência em Kiev. “É perfeitamente possível que o alvo pretendido pelo drone russo fosse o trem diplomático, que partiu da estação antes do previsto após os horários dos trens terem sido ajustados em tempo real devido à constante ameaça de ataques russos”, informou a operadora ferroviária ucraniana, Ukrzaliznytsia, no Telegram. Boris Johnson, que também estava no trem que partiu da estação pouco antes do ataque, condenou o ataque como “aleatório e sem sentido” em uma publicação no Instagram. Com a linha de frente da guerra praticamente imóvel, tanto Moscou quanto Kiev intensificaram os ataques de longo alcance nas últimas semanas para tentar mudar o rumo da guerra. O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Polônia, Radoslaw Sikorski, descreveu os crescentes ataques da Rússia às portas da Otan como “uma escalada”. No início do domingo, um caminhão a menos de 1 km da fronteira da Ucrânia com a Polônia também foi atingido, levando o posto de fronteira de Dorohusk-Yahodyn a interromper brevemente suas operações, segundo guardas de fronteira. O Ministério da Defesa da Rússia afirmou ter atacado infraestruturas que facilitam o transporte de cargas militares da Europa no oeste da Ucrânia. A Rússia começou a atacar os postos de fronteira da Ucrânia com seus aliados ocidentais nas últimas semanas, como parte de uma campanha crescente de ambos os lados para minar a infraestrutura econômica do adversário, mais de quatro anos após o início da invasão russa. (Reportagem de Felix Light, Pavel Polityuk, Andriy Perun e Anna Wlodarczak-Semczuk)

item.title: Ahead of Fed meeting, Trump says US should have world's lowest interest rate
item.description: No country should have lower interest rates than the U.S., President Donald Trump said on Sunday, days before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin, Conor Humphries
item.content:encoded: No country should have lower interest rates than the U.S., President Donald Trump said on Sunday, days before the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting. Speaking to reporters at the Irish Open golf tournament, Trump said he did not know whether Fed policymakers will raise interest rates at their meeting this week. But he said the U.S. "should be paying the lowest interest rate in the world" no matter what the Federal Reserve's data indicates about inflation and the economy. The Labor Department's Consumer Price Index, a key measure of [USN:L1N452123 TEXT:"underlying inflation"], on Friday posted its largest increase in four months. That reinforced expectations that the U.S. central bank will raise the target range for its federal funds rate, now at 3.5% to 3.75%, at the conclusion of its Federal Open Market Committee meeting on Wednesday. Price pressures remain elevated as the economy deals with Trump's import tax increases and surging energy prices tied to the Iran war. Many at the Fed worry that the longer inflation remains high, the greater the cost will be to get it back to target. The central bank's governors are meeting just weeks before midterm elections that will determine whether Republicans keep their slim majorities in both chambers of the U.S. Congress. A rate hike could add to voter concerns about affordability, according to recent [USN:L6N44M0S0 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos"] polls. Trump's approval ratings have fallen as inflation has persisted. He has argued that the Fed's interest rate levels have helped other countries at the expense of the U.S. “I know more about formulas than anybody, and with the best credit in the world, we make other countries rich," Trump said on Sunday. The president, a frequent critic of former Fed Chair Jay Powell, has been more supportive of Fed leadership since his own pick for chair, Kevin Warsh, took charge earlier this year. But Trump recently has made his demands more clear. "LOWER THE RATE OR I'LL STOP TRADING WITH COUNTRIES WITH WHICH WE HAVE A DEFICIT," Trump posted on social media two weeks ago. In additional remarks to reporters later on Sunday before he boarded a plane to return to the U.S., Trump reiterated that threat and said: "We don't want to have deficits with nations. We want to have surpluses or at least break-evens." Trump "will defend the independence of Kevin Warsh above all" no matter what the Fed does with interest rates, National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett told "Fox News Sunday." But Hassett also underscored Trump's own preferences, saying that if the Fed raises rates, "I'm sure he's not going to be super happy about it."

item.title: Turquía detiene a decenas de personas tras serie de redadas dirigidas contra grupos LGBTQ+
item.description: Las autoridades turcas detuvieron al menos a 47 personas tras una serie de redadas en las oficinas de asociaciones LGBTQ+ en el marco de una investigación sobre prostitución y obscenidad, informó la fiscalía.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades turcas detuvieron al menos a 47 personas tras una serie de redadas en las oficinas de asociaciones LGBTQ+ en el marco de una investigación sobre prostitución y obscenidad, informó la fiscalía. Esta campaña de represión forma parte de una iniciativa que, según el Gobierno, tiene como objetivo proteger los valores familiares. La Fiscalía General de Estambul informó que durante el fin de semana se llevaron a cabo operaciones en 12 provincias contra 38 sospechosos, de los cuales 26 fueron detenidos, y las autoridades incautaron drogas, equipos digitales, alcohol de contrabando y un arma de fuego. En un comunicado aparte, la Fiscalía General de Ankara indicó que otras 21 personas habían sido detenidas en el marco de una investigación sobre la asociación LGBTQ+ Kaos GL y que aún se buscaba a cinco personas. Kaos GL dijo que al menos 50 activistas habían sido detenidos, entre ellos más de 10 que fueron detenidos en redadas policiales en sus domicilios. Además, señaló que las autoridades bloquearon el acceso a decenas de sitios web y cuentas en redes sociales vinculadas a organizaciones LGBTQ+ y activistas. Bajo el lema "Mi familia está a salvo", la campaña de represión del Gobierno se produce mientras el presidente Tayyip Erdogan promueve la "Década de la Familia y la Población", una iniciativa destinada a hacer frente a la caída de la natalidad y al envejecimiento de la población. Las organizaciones de derechos humanos han acusado al Gobierno turco de atacar cada vez más a la comunidad LGBTQ+ en los últimos años mediante un endurecimiento de la retórica y las restricciones. "El verdadero nombre de esta operación no es 'Mi familia está a salvo'; se trata de discriminación impulsada por el Estado, política del miedo y desmantelamiento de la sociedad civil", dijo la Asociación Turca de Derechos Humanos en X. Nacho Sánchez Amor, ponente del Parlamento Europeo para Turquía, calificó la amplia oleada de detenciones como "una escalada impactante" de la represión. "Esta imposición de una agenda moral constituye una violación flagrante de los derechos fundamentales y de los compromisos internacionales de Turquía, lo que lleva al país por un camino oscuro", dijo Amor en una publicación en X. La fiscalía dijo que existían pruebas de que se estaba ejerciendo una influencia inadecuada sobre niños y menores en cuestiones relacionadas con la orientación sexual y la identidad de género. El ministro de Justicia, Akin Gurlek, dijo que las investigaciones coordinadas por las fiscalías de Estambul, Ankara, Esmirna, Aydin y Mersin incluían procedimientos judiciales contra 162 sospechosos, nueve asociaciones y 13 empresas en 15 provincias.

item.title: Orioles put RHP Kyle Bradish on IL, likely ending his season
item.description: Baltimore right-hander Kyle Bradish could miss the rest of the season after the Orioles placed him on the 15-day injured list Sunday with lower abdominal discomfort.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore right-hander Kyle Bradish could miss the rest of the season after the Orioles placed him on the 15-day injured list Sunday with lower abdominal discomfort. The Orioles recalled right-hander Yaramil Hiraldo from Triple-A Norfolk to fill Bradish's roster spot. Bradish, 30, who signed a five-year, $90 million contract extension in July, is 7-14 with a 4.12 ERA in 29 starts this season. Of late, he has given up five earned runs or more in three of his last nine starts and has failed to pitch five innings five times in that span. Drafted by the Los Angeles Angels in the fourth round in 2018 and acquired by the Orioles in 2019, Bradish debuted in 2022 and is 26-29 in 96 starts with a 3.67 ERA over 512 2/3 innings. He underwent Tommy John surgery in June 2024 and made just six starts last season. Hiraldo, 30, is 1-0 with a 5.87 ERA in seven relief appearances this season after posting a 4.58 ERA in 18 relief outings last season, his first in the majors. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump diz que “forças muito negativas” estão gerando preocupações exageradas sobre a IA
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comparou neste domingo os críticos da inteligência artificial a “forças muito negativas” que levantam cenários que não vão acontecer, e afirmou que quer garantir que os EUA continuem sendo líderes do setor.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comparou neste domingo os críticos da inteligência artificial a “forças muito negativas” que levantam cenários que não vão acontecer, e afirmou que quer garantir que os EUA continuem sendo líderes do setor. “Estamos à frente da China em IA. Somos o país mais sofisticado do mundo e, francamente, quero que continue assim, porque quem vencer na IA vence”, disse Trump a repórteres em seu campo de golfe na Irlanda, quando questionado se o setor de IA deveria desacelerar ou ser mais regulamentado. “Poderíamos estabelecer limites. Podemos fazer isso e aquilo. Mas acho que há muitas forças muito negativas levantando essa questão, que não deveriam estar fazendo isso, e estão trazendo à tona coisas que não vão acontecer.” Trump tem resistido a alimentar preocupações sobre a IA. O debate público sobre a IA se intensificou nos EUA depois que dois pesquisadores da Anthropic alertaram que o rápido avanço da tecnologia poderia levar à extinção da raça humana em um futuro não muito distante. Em seu segundo mandato, Trump tem apoiado amplamente as empresas de IA. Esses líderes do setor de IA e outras empresas de tecnologia também têm apoiado as iniciativas de Trump. Executivos do setor de IA injetaram dinheiro na campanha para as eleições legislativas de meio de mandato, que acontecerão em 3 de novembro e determinarão o controle do Congresso dos EUA. O grupo de financiamento eleitoral do presidente-executivo da SpaceX, Elon Musk, o America PAC, já gastou milhões apoiando candidatos republicanos e deve desempenhar um papel importante nos esforços para aumentar a participação eleitoral. O Pentágono alertou este ano sobre os riscos do modelo da Anthropic. Após os alertas dos pesquisadores, alguns presidentes-executivos do setor de IA estão pressionando para que o avanço dos modelos seja desacelerado. No sábado, o presidente-executivo da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, apresentou uma estrutura em três etapas destinada a moderar o ritmo do desenvolvimento e criar mais tempo para gerenciar os riscos. A proposta recebeu imediatamente o apoio de vários outros executivos de grandes empresas de IA, incluindo Musk e o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman. Em uma entrevista exibida no domingo no programa da CBS “Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan”, Amodei disse que a competição entre empresas de IA dos EUA e da China é o “dilema mais difícil” na tentativa de estabelecer um “limite de velocidade” para o ritmo de desenvolvimento da IA. “Não devemos nos iludir, porque os incentivos para sair na frente e a vantagem militar que se obtém com isso são tão grandes que a capacidade de verificar se o outro lado não está trapaceando precisa ser irrefutável”, disse ele. “Portanto, acho que isso vai levar anos, e, honestamente, não sei se é possível.” Jacob Coxon, um dos pesquisadores da Anthropic que se demitiu e depois emitiu os alertas, defendeu que os EUA trabalhem em conjunto com outros países para garantir um ritmo equilibrado. “Acho que precisamos de coordenação internacional; caso contrário, corremos o risco de entrar na mesma corrida que a China, o que poderia ser igualmente perigoso”, disse Coxon no programa Meet the Press, da NBC. (Reportagem de Bo Erickson; Reportagem adicional de Joseph Ax)

item.title: Kane winner hands Bayern laborious 2-1 win at promoted Elversberg
item.description: Visitors Bayern Munich needed a second-half winner from Harry Kane to battle past promoted Elversberg 2-1 on Sunday, and snap the hosts two-game winning start to the season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Visitors Bayern Munich needed a second-half winner from Harry Kane to battle past promoted Elversberg 2-1 on Sunday, and snap the hosts two-game winning start to the season. Kane threaded a shot past two defenders and the Elversberg keeper in the 72nd minute to hand the champions a nervous victory against the Bundesliga newcomers. Elversberg, buoyed by wins over Bayer Leverkusen and Borussia Moenchengladbach in their previous two league outings, showed no signs of being overawed by their illustrious opponents in their first ever Bundesliga encounter and had the visitors on the backfoot at the start. They also had the better scoring chances until Ismael Saibari found just enough space down the left to cut back into the box for Lennart Karl to finish the move with a tap-in at the far post in the 26th minute. But Vincent Kompany's team eased off almost instantly and the hosts bounced back, striking just past the hour mark when Maurice Krattenmacher curled a stunning effort into the top far corner to level. The Bavarians heeded the wake-up call, hit the woodwork with Michael Olise in the 70th before England captain Kane bagged the winner two minutes later. Bayern climbed up to fourth in the Bundesliga on seven points, two off leaders Freiburg and Borussia Dortmund, who have three wins from three matches. Elversberg are a point behind in sixth place.

item.title: Trump says he is lifting tariffs on Irish whiskey
item.dc:creator: Reuters

item.title: India cruise past Afghanistan as Sharma blitz earns series lead
item.description: India claimed a dominant seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first Twenty20 international in New Delhi on Sunday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series after chasing down a victory target of 157 with 38 balls to spare.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India claimed a dominant seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first Twenty20 international in New Delhi on Sunday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series after chasing down a victory target of 157 with 38 balls to spare. After Sanju Samson fell in the third over, Abhishek Sharma launched a blistering counterattack, smashing 82 off 32 balls, while Ishan Kishan contributed 42 as the pair put India firmly in control of the chase. Sharma's aggressive strokeplay ensured Afghanistan never threatened the target, with India cruising towards victory before Mohammad Nabi struck twice late in the innings to remove both Sharma and Kishan. Captain Shreyas Iyer and Tilak Varma then guided their side over the line, with Iyer finishing unbeaten on eight from five deliveries. Afghanistan had earlier made a poor start after being put in to bat, with Jasprit Bumrah, returning to the side after a knee injury, striking in the opening over to dismiss Rahmanullah Gurbaz for a duck. They slipped to 41-4 inside the powerplay, with captain Ibrahim Zadran (11) and Sediqullah Atal (13) among the early casualties. A steady stream of wickets kept Afghanistan under pressure throughout the innings, but Azmatullah Omarzai provided some resistance with a counter-attacking 64 off 44 balls. The all-rounder shared a crucial 83-run partnership with Mohammad Nabi (33) to revive the innings before Nabi fell to Arshdeep Singh, who applied the brakes in the death overs and finished with figures of 3-19. India will face Afghanistan next on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump says he is removing U.S. tariffs on Irish whiskey
item.description: Trump made the announcement in front of a crowd of Irish golf fans at a tournament held at a course owned by his family.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump said at the end of a visit to Ireland on Sunday that he would remove a 10% tariff on Irish whiskey, a duty that currently falls under those imposed on all European Union wine and spirit exports to the United States. Trump made the announcement in front of a crowd of Irish golf fans [USN:L8N4550BK TEXT:"at a tournament"] held at a course owned by his family. He met Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin in Dublin on Saturday at the start of a [USN:L6N454021 TEXT:"48-hour visit"] to the country. "Taoiseach (Ireland's Prime Minister) and I talked about it and Shane (golfer Shane Lowry) talked about it and everybody has been bugging me saying 'would you do me a favor? It's so unfair what's going on. Could you possibly take the tariffs off of Irish whiskey?," Trump said. "And I said on behalf of the United States of America, I am going to take the tariffs off Irish whiskey," he announced to loud cheers from the crowd. Wine and spirits exports to the U.S. were included in a 15% tariff applied on most items under a [USN:L6N42O0QH TEXT:"EU-U.S. trade deal"] struck last year. Subsequent new U.S. tariffs on 60 trading partners in July, [USN:L6N43Q0EE TEXT:"including the EU"], brought the rate down to 10%. The move was [USN:L6N43Q08M TEXT:"part of efforts"] to rebuild Trump's near-global tariff wall after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down his initial duties. The Irish Whiskey Association (IWA) welcomed the announcement and said it would continue to work with its EU and U.S. counterparts to secure a return to the zero-for-zero tariff arrangement for all drinks exports. "Nothing exemplifies the US-Ireland trade relationship better than Irish Whiskey," IWA Director Eoin O Caitin said in a statement, adding that the lobby group looked forward to seeing the announcement fully implemented.

item.title: Mas gana La Vuelta a España y logra su primera victoria en una Gran Vuelta
item.description: Enric Mas, del equipo Movistar, ganó el domingo La Vuelta a España y se alzó con su primera victoria en una Gran Vuelta, convirtiéndose en el primer ciclista español en ganar la carrera desde Alberto Contador en 2014, mientras que Tobias Johannessen, del equipo Uno-X Mobility, se impuso en la última etapa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Enric Mas, del equipo Movistar, ganó el domingo La Vuelta a España y se alzó con su primera victoria en una Gran Vuelta, convirtiéndose en el primer ciclista español en ganar la carrera desde Alberto Contador en 2014, mientras que Tobias Johannessen, del equipo Uno-X Mobility, se impuso en la última etapa. Mas prácticamente se aseguró la victoria al superar la brutal penúltima etapa del sábado en la Sierra Nevada, donde consiguió una ventaja de más de dos minutos de cara a la etapa final del domingo en Granada. Tras haber quedado tres veces subcampeón de la Vuelta en 2018, 2021 y 2022, Mas subió por fin al escalón más alto con el maillot rojo, consiguiendo su primer título de Gran Vuelta en su propio país. Terminó con una ventaja de 2 minutos y 15 segundos sobre Primož Roglič, de Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, mientras que Félix Gall, del Decathlon CMA CGM Team, quedó tercero. Mas había heredado el maillot rojo después de que el intento del gran favorito de la carrera, Tadej Pogačar, de completar el triplete en las Grandes Vueltas del ciclismo, llegó a un doloroso final al sufrir una caída en la octava etapa. Johannessen ganó la etapa final —en la que se neutralizaron los tiempos de la clasificación general para la cuarta y última vuelta—, superando en la línea de meta a Alessandro Romele, de XDS Astana, y a Ramses Debruyne, de Alpecin-Premier Tech. Mas terminó luego con el pelotón y cruzó la línea de meta flanqueado por sus compañeros del Movistar, mientras el público lo animaba a gritos.

item.title: Gol de Haaland dá ao City vitória sobre o United
item.description: Erling Haaland marcou no segundo tempo e garantiu a vitória por 1 x 0 do Manchester City, que jogava com 10 jogadores, sobre seu arquirrival Manchester United, no Old Trafford, neste domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Erling Haaland marcou no segundo tempo e garantiu a vitória por 1 x 0 do Manchester City, que jogava com 10 jogadores, sobre seu arquirrival Manchester United, no Old Trafford, neste domingo. O gol foi inicialmente anulado por impedimento, mas a decisão foi revertida após uma revisão do VAR. Phil Foden, do City, foi expulso no meio do primeiro tempo por dar um chute em Bruno Fernandes, e o United acertou a trave duas vezes, por meio de Marcus Rashford e Kobbie Mainoo, antes e depois do intervalo, enquanto tentava aproveitar a vantagem numérica. No entanto, a maré virou aos 15 minutos do segundo tempo, quando Haaland mandou a bola para o fundo da rede de um ângulo fechado e, embora o gol tenha sido inicialmente anulado por impedimento, uma revisão do VAR levou à reversão da decisão, com imagens de vídeo mostrando que o pé estendido do zagueiro Patrick Dorgu manteve o norueguês em posição válida. Com a vitória, o City sobe para a segunda colocação do Campeonato Inglês, com 12 pontos em quatro partidas, atrás do campeão Arsenal apenas no saldo de gols, enquanto o United ocupa a 13ª posição, com quatro pontos em quatro partidas. (Reportagem de Andy Cawthorne, em Manchester)

item.title: Mas ends long wait for Grand Tour glory with home Vuelta win
item.description: Movistar's Enric Mas ended years of heartbreak by winning the Vuelta a Espana on Sunday, claiming his maiden Grand Tour victory while also becoming the first Spanish champion since Alberto Contador in 2014.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Movistar's Enric Mas ended years of heartbreak by winning the Vuelta a Espana on Sunday, claiming his maiden Grand Tour victory while also becoming the first Spanish champion since Alberto Contador in 2014. Mas all but secured the win when he survived [USN:L1N45404E TEXT:"Saturday's brutal penultimate stage"] in the Sierra Nevada mountains, where he established a lead of over two minutes ahead of the ceremonial final stage in Granada won by Tobias Johannessen of Uno-X Mobility. A three-time runner-up in the Vuelta in 2018, 2021 and 2022, the 31-year-old Mas finally stood on the top step with the red jersey, claiming the biggest victory of his career after racing through over 3,000 kilometres on home roads. "It's just special. It's been a day to remember, a special Vuelta, and it has been wonderful," Mas said. "There's always tension about what could happen, but you've seen it all went smoothly, so we're delighted and we enjoyed every kilometre today. "It was a long wait and a long way to today. But to be honest, it was always special Vueltas. This one, I think, is the special one." He finished two minutes and 15 seconds ahead of Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe rider Primoz Roglic while Felix Gall of Decathlon CMA CGM Team came in third. Mas had inherited the red jersey after overwhelming race favourite Tadej Pogacar's bid to complete cycling's Grand Tour hat-trick came to a painful end when he [USN:L6N44Q04G TEXT:"crashed out on stage eight"], bringing his season to a premature end. GENUINE CONTENDER However, Mas was up to the task, defending the red jersey and turning an unexpected opportunity into the biggest victory of his career. He dropped four-times Vuelta champion Roglic in the final kilometres of stage 20 to effectively win the general classification battle, denying the Slovenian what would have been a record fifth title. Johannessen won the final stage -- where the general classification times for the fourth and final circuit were neutralised -- beating Alessandro Romele (XDS Astana) and Ramses Debruyne (Alpecin-Premier Tech) to the finish line. "I've been knocking on that door for a long time, well over three years since the last time. It feels really special to do it today. I don't know what to say. I'm so happy," Johannessen said. Mas then finished with the bunch and crossed the line with his Movistar teammates by his side and the crowd roaring him on before he thanked his family. "They are the ones responsible for all of this, for the fact that I'm up here on the top step," Mas said. "Truly, from the bottom of my heart, thank you so much. The fans have been amazing since we started the season, so please keep it up, it helps us a lot."

item.title: Trump diz que EUA podem permanecer no Irã e ficar com petróleo
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sugeriu neste domingo que os EUA podem permanecer no Irã e “ficar com o petróleo”, traçando um paralelo com a tentativa do país de assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Conor Humphries
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sugeriu neste domingo que os EUA podem permanecer no Irã e “ficar com o petróleo”, traçando um paralelo com a tentativa do país de assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela. Durante uma viagem à Irlanda para reuniões e para assistir a partidas de golfe, ele reiterou que ainda espera que a guerra no Irã termine este ano, possivelmente logo após as eleições legislativas de meio de mandato previstas para novembro nos Estados Unidos. Falando no campeonato de golfe Irish Open, Trump acrescentou que o preço da gasolina “cairia vertiginosamente” assim que a guerra no Irã terminasse. A turbulência no Oriente Médio tem abalado os mercados de petróleo, com os operadores do setor esperando que os preços voltem a subir na segunda-feira, após um ataque a um oleoduto saudita. Trump afirmou que só fecharia o “acordo certo” e não aceitará um que seja “ruim”, acrescentando que o Irã está “pedindo constantemente” por negociações de paz — uma afirmação que Teerã já rejeitou no passado. Mas o presidente também apresentou outra opção: manter o diálogo com o Irã. Ele traçou um paralelo com o acordo dos EUA com a Venezuela, anunciado em agosto. “No fim das contas, vamos sair (do Irã), a menos que decidamos ficar e ficar com o petróleo, como na Venezuela”, disse Trump, acrescentando que a receita obtida pelos EUA na Venezuela “pagou a guerra muitas vezes”. (Reportagem de Bo Erickson, em Doonbeg, e Padraic Halpin e Conor Humphries, em Dublin)

item.title: Israel y el Líbano se reunirán en Roma en octubre, dice funcionario del Departamento de Estado EEUU
item.description: Israel y el Líbano se reunirán en Roma en octubre para debatir un acuerdo de seguridad negociado por Estados Unidos con el objetivo de aliviar las hostilidades a lo largo de la frontera, dijo a Reuters un responsable del Departamento de Estado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israel y el Líbano se reunirán en Roma en octubre para debatir un acuerdo de seguridad negociado por Estados Unidos con el objetivo de aliviar las hostilidades a lo largo de la frontera, dijo a Reuters un responsable del Departamento de Estado. La aplicación continuada del acuerdo "sigue siendo el único mecanismo viable para restablecer la soberanía del Líbano y la seguridad de Israel", dijo el funcionario, que añadió que los embajadores libanés e israelí se reunirán en Washington la próxima semana. La séptima ronda de negociaciones en la capital italiana concluyó en agosto sin que se lograra ningún avance en cuestiones territoriales clave. Hezbolá e Israel volvieron a entrar en guerra el 2 de marzo en medio de un conflicto regional más amplio. El Ejército israelí ocupa lo que describe como una "zona de contención" de unos 10 km (6 millas) de profundidad en el Líbano a lo largo de toda la frontera israelí. Las autoridades israelíes dicen que la zona es necesaria para proteger a las comunidades del norte de Israel de los ataques lanzados por Hezbolá. Más de 4.300 personas han perdido la vida a causa de los ataques israelíes en el Líbano desde marzo, según el Ministerio de Salud libanés.

item.title: Lille go top as Lens rally to draw 2-2 at Le Mans
item.description: Last season’s runners-up RC Lens fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at promoted Le Mans on Sunday, while Lille went top of the Ligue 1 standings after an easy 2-0 triumph over Troyes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Last season’s runners-up RC Lens fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at promoted Le Mans on Sunday, while Lille went top of the Ligue 1 standings after an easy 2-0 triumph over Troyes. The victory put Lille top with 10 points from four matches, ahead of Monaco and Rennes on goal difference. Lens, who had lost two of their opening three fixtures of the campaign, moved to four points while Le Mans are still looking for their first win of the season. Le Mans looked in command in the first half at Stade Marie-Marvingt after Adil Bourabaa headed home a rebound after Louis Mafouta’s effort bounced back off the crossbar in the 32nd minute and then a quick counter-attack allowed Lucas Calodat to double their advantage in the 44th minute. Lens pulled one back from tall Senegalese striker Abdallah Sima in stoppage time before the break and then equalised with another header, this time from substitute Franjo Ivanovic six minutes into the second half. Thorgan Hazard hammered a free kick against the crossbar in the 80th minute as Lens came within inches of completing a turnaround. Lille bounced back after their home loss to Real Betis in the Champions League in midweek to easily beat Troyes in a one-sided encounter at Stade Pierre-Mauroy. Fullback Tiago Santos scored for a second time this season as he curled a first-time, right-footed shot into the far top corner. Ethan Mbappe, sent off in the Champions League in midweek, came on as a substitute to add the second goal in stoppage time. Later on Sunday, champions Paris St Germain will seek their first league win of the season as they visit Stade Brestois.

item.title: Bolt unfazed by robot's record run, eyes Manchester derby instead
item.description: Most athletes might bristle at seeing their records being broken. When eight-time Olympic champion Usain Bolt learned that a robot in China had eclipsed his 100-metres world record by almost a second, he was rather amused by the turn of events.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Most athletes might bristle at seeing their records being broken. When eight-time Olympic champion Usain Bolt learned that a robot in China had eclipsed his 100-metres world record by almost a second, he was rather amused by the turn of events. "It's just one of those things. I guess that's where the world is going right now," the Jamaican said with a laugh and a shrug. "It just made me smile." A couple of weeks ago, "Robot beats Bolt" was splashed across headlines after [USN:L8N44N18V TEXT:"Tiangong Ultra"] won the 100m final at the second World Humanoid Robot Games, clocking 8.64 seconds, almost a second faster than Bolt's 9.58 world-record set in 2009. The 40-year-old Bolt was in relaxed form as he met reporters in Budapest on the final day of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship, delivering a stream of anecdotes and one-liners that showed why he remains one of athletics' most magnetic personalities. Although from the outset, Bolt appeared keen to wrap things up early. "United is playing right now (versus City in the Manchester derby)," said the lifelong Manchester United supporter. "Very important time." Bolt also reflected on his place in sporting history and how he hoped to be remembered, saying his ambition was never simply to dominate athletics, but to transcend it. "My goal was always to be among the greats in sports," he said. "That when the conversation is being talked about Muhammad Ali ... and all these greats in different sports, I'm mentioned in that sentence. I'm happy that I'm actually in the conversation." Bolt scolded reporters who had suggested at last year's world championships in Tokyo that he was out of shape. "First of all, I made a joke and you guys took it out of context. It was everywhere!" he said. "I wasn't running out of breath walking up the stairs. I was just making a joke. I'm in the best shape of my life, guys." His declaration drew laughter around the room. "Listen, 'he's in the best shape of his life'. That's the headline," he said laughing before adding that he still works out daily. Bolt flirted with a football career, but it ended in 2018 after a two-month trial with Australian club Central Coast Mariners, where he scored twice in a friendly on his first start. But he had no answer for how his name was recently linked to Wythenshawe Vets FC, a Sunday league team in south Manchester that has gained attention for recruiting former Premier League players. While Wythenshawe's supposed superstar signing made headlines, Bolt insisted he first learned about it when his longtime agent Ricky Simms contacted him. "Ricky texted me and said, 'Are you playing football now?' And I was like, 'I don't know what's going on'." Simms offered his own explanation. "I think they wanted to have the option if he's ever in Manchester and wants to play." And if any non-league club is still holding out hope of signing the fastest man in history, Bolt sounded in no rush to dust off his boots, preferring instead to keep an eye on Manchester United and enjoy retirement.

item.title: Haaland strike gives 10-man Man City contentious 1-0 derby win over Man United
item.description: Erling Haaland scored in the second half to give 10-man Manchester City a 1-0 Premier League win at bitter rivals Manchester United on Sunday, with the strike initially disallowed for offside before the decision was overturned following a lengthy and contentious VAR review.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Erling Haaland scored in the second half to give 10-man Manchester City a 1-0 Premier League win at bitter rivals Manchester United on Sunday, with the strike initially disallowed for offside before the decision was overturned following a lengthy and contentious VAR review. The match had burst into life with the sending-off of City's Phil Foden in the 23rd minute for kicking out at Bruno Fernandes, yet it was United who ended the encounter feeling hard done by. Haaland was flagged offside after steering Josko Gvardiol’s cross into the net from a tight angle in the 60th minute, but replays showed that Patrick Dorgu’s outstretched foot had played the Norwegian onside. The review was prolonged by the involvement of Enzo Fernandez, who was in an offside position and launched himself at the cross without making contact. The VAR ruled the goal could stand, however, even though Fernandez's attempt appeared to affect Lisandro Martinez’s efforts to cut out the delivery. The game simmered for the opening period before the sending-off of Foden for kicking Fernandes in the stomach from a prone position. Though the kick lacked power, it made no difference to referee Michael Oliver, who brandished the red card. Enzo Maresca's side retreated into a compact defensive block, and initially appeared comfortable despite their numerical disadvantage, although they offered little threat going forward. Marcus Rashford almost gave the home side the lead just before the break when Fernandez conceded a free kick outside the box, but the winger's effort struck the left-hand post. NO OFFSIDE OFFENCE United hit the woodwork again six minutes after the restart when Kobbie Mainoo let fly from distance, but the momentum shifted on the hour as Haaland steered Gvardiol’s cross home from a tight angle. The assistant referee’s flag cut short City’s celebrations, only for VAR to rule that Dorgu had played Haaland onside and that Fernandez’s unsuccessful attempt to reach the ball did not constitute an offside offence. City keeper Gianluigi Donnarumma made a tremendous save in stoppage time to deny Bryan Mbeumo as City held on for a win that leaves them second in the table on 12 points from four games, behind champions Arsenal on goal difference, while United are 13th with four points from four games. "It's a kind of new experience to win with 10 men and it's amazing, I have to be honest," Haaland told broadcaster Sky Sports. "We need fighters in the team, which we have plenty of ... I'm super happy with every single one, and I'm so so proud of everyone ... I think we even became sharper when we became 10 men. That's how we have to play all the time, with 11 men as well." Haaland admitted he had initially been unsure why the goal was allowed to stand. "I think there was a flick, so I thought maybe there was someone who flicked it, because I normally don't go offside. So I told Michael Oliver I took it a bit personally that he thought it was offside," he joked. "But I looked over to Enzo, the gaffer, and he gave me a thumbs up and then I kind of knew that it was a goal, so I prepared myself a bit to celebrate."

item.title: Trump diz a Zelenskiy para parar de atacar diesel russo
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse neste domingo ao presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, que pare de atacar a infraestrutura russa de diesel, afirmando que os ataques estão causando escassez do combustível que está “prejudicando o mundo”.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse neste domingo ao presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, que pare de atacar a infraestrutura russa de diesel, afirmando que os ataques estão causando escassez do combustível que está “prejudicando o mundo”. Uma onda de ataques ucranianos com drones de longo alcance contra refinarias de petróleo russas nos últimos meses reduziu a produção de combustível da Rússia, provocando escassez de gasolina em todo o território. A Ucrânia, que enfrenta ataques russos regulares à sua própria infraestrutura energética, afirma que as refinarias são alvos militares legítimos. O preço médio nacional do diesel nos EUA — utilizado por caminhões, trens, navios e equipamentos agrícolas — ultrapassou US$6 por galão pela primeira vez na quinta-feira, de acordo com o site de acompanhamento de preços GasBuddy. “O Sr. Zelenskiy precisa fazer uma coisa: ele precisa parar de destruir o estoque de diesel na Rússia”, disse Trump a jornalistas durante uma visita ao torneio de golfe Irish Open, que está sendo realizado no oeste da Irlanda, em um campo de golfe de propriedade de sua família. “Conversamos com o Sr. Zelenskiy sobre isso. Há muitos outros alvos. Não atinjam o diesel. Isso está prejudicando o mundo”, disse ele. A escassez global “não é causada pelo Oriente Médio, mas sim pelo que está acontecendo com a Rússia e a Ucrânia”, acrescentou Trump. A Rússia reduziu sua previsão de produção de petróleo para este ano para o nível mais baixo em 17 anos e revisou suas perspectivas de exportação de combustível para 2026 e 2027 devido à guerra, de acordo com um rascunho de previsão do governo analisado pela Reuters. (Reportagem de Bo Erickson)

item.title: Report: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) out 1 month
item.description: A non-contact left ankle injury in San Francisco's season-opening victory will keep 49ers rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling sidelined for at least a month, NFL Network reported Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A non-contact left ankle injury in San Francisco's season-opening victory will keep 49ers rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling sidelined for at least a month, NFL Network reported Sunday. Stribling was injured in the second quarter of the 49ers' 27-7 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Thursday in Australia and did not return. According to the report, the injury is a deltoid ligament sprain. The former Ole Miss star might need to have surgery, per the report, but it had not been determined as of Sunday morning. After the game, head coach Kyle Shanahan said that the rookie's Achilles was intact, but that more tests were required to determine the exact nature of the injury. The 49ers chose Stribling, 23, with the first pick of the second round (No. 33 overall) in the 2026 NFL Draft. The Hawaii native earned more playing time after impressing the team at training camp. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rusia ataca un tren de pasajeros en frontera de Ucrania con Polonia, no alcanza a "tren diplomático"
item.description: Un dron ruso impactó el domingo contra un tren de pasajeros en la frontera de Ucrania con Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, poco después de que el ex primer ministro británico Boris Johnson y otros diplomáticos europeos utilizaron la misma línea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un dron ruso impactó el domingo contra un tren de pasajeros en la frontera de Ucrania con Polonia, país miembro de la OTAN, poco después de que el ex primer ministro británico Boris Johnson y otros diplomáticos europeos utilizaron la misma línea. El tren, que circulaba por una ruta muy utilizada por las delegaciones extranjeras que regresan de Kiev, fue atacado a solo 2 kilómetros (1,2 millas) de la frontera polaca, informó la empresa ferroviaria ucraniana. No se han registrado víctimas. "No era nuestro tren, sino el que iba unos minutos detrás de nosotros por el paso fronterizo. Se evacuó cuando se acercó el dron y nadie resultó herido", dijo Carl Bildt, ex primer ministro de Suecia, en X. Él y otros políticos regresaban a Europa en tren tras asistir a una conferencia en Kiev. "Es muy posible que el objetivo del dron ruso fuera el tren diplomático, que salió de la estación antes de lo previsto tras ajustarse los horarios de los trenes en tiempo real debido a la amenaza constante de ataques rusos", dijo en Telegram la empresa ferroviaria ucraniana, Ukrzaliznytsia. Boris Johnson, que también se encontraba en el tren que salió de la estación poco antes del ataque, condenó este como "aleatorio y sin sentido" en una publicación en Instagram. Dado que la línea del frente se mantiene prácticamente estática, tanto Moscú como Kiev han intensificado los ataques a larga distancia en las últimas semanas para intentar cambiar el rumbo de la guerra. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores polaco, Radoslaw Sikorski, calificó los crecientes ataques de Rusia a las puertas de la OTAN como "una escalada". El domingo por la mañana, un camión situado a menos de 1 km de la frontera de Ucrania con Polonia también fue alcanzado, lo que provocó que el paso fronterizo de Dorohusk-Yahodyn suspendiera brevemente sus operaciones, según los guardias fronterizos. El Ministerio de Defensa ruso dijo que había atacado infraestructuras que facilitaban el transporte de cargamentos militares procedentes de Europa en el oeste de Ucrania. Rusia ha comenzado a atacar en las últimas semanas los pasos fronterizos de Ucrania con sus aliados occidentales, como parte de una campaña cada vez más intensa por ambas partes para debilitar la infraestructura económica del adversario, cuando ya se han cumplido más de cuatro años desde el inicio de la invasión rusa. RUSIA REPORTA ATAQUE CERCA DE CENTRAL NUCLEAR DE ZAPORIYIA Durante la noche, las hostilidades no dieron señales de amainar. En la parte controlada por Rusia de la región de Zaporiyia, al sureste de Ucrania, el director de Rosatom, la empresa estatal rusa de energía nuclear, acusó a Ucrania de atacar camiones de combustible cerca de la central nuclear de Zaporiyia, la mayor de Europa. La central nuclear de Zaporiyia está bajo control ruso desde marzo de 2022 y sigue situada cerca de la línea del frente. Un portavoz militar ucraniano no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. En la propia Rusia, el alcalde de la ciudad de Nizhnekamsk, en la región del río Volga, en Tartaristán, afirmó que objetivos "civiles e industriales" de la ciudad habían sido atacados por drones ucranianos, lo que provocó al menos dos muertos y varios heridos más. El alcalde, Radmir Belyaev, no aclaró qué objetivos habían sido alcanzados, pero la ciudad alberga una importante refinería de petróleo que ya ha sido objeto de ataques en el pasado. Las autoridades ucranianas no se pronunciaron de inmediato sobre el ataque a Nizhnekamsk, pero sí dijeron que habían atacado otra refinería en la región meridional de Krasnodar.

item.title: Team Europe jolts Americans, reclaims Solheim Cup
item.description: Team Europe regained the Solheim Cup with a 15-13 victory over the United States on Sunday in Den Bosch, Netherlands.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Team Europe regained the Solheim Cup with a 15-13 victory over the United States on Sunday in Den Bosch, Netherlands. Lottie Woad sank a 2-foot putt on the 17th hole to record a 2&1 win over Auston Kim, pushing the Europeans past the 14 1/2-point threshold at Bernardus Golf. That included Carlota Ciganda's guaranteed half point in her match. The successful putt ignited a celebration that featured Woad leaping into the arms of her teammates as Europe reveled in its eighth win in the event and avenged the United States' victory in 2024. Woad admitted she wasn't sure if it was her match or that of Carlota Ciganda that ultimately would cement the victory for Team Europe. "I knew it was mine or Carlota's match," Woad said. "And when Auston made those three birdies in a row that was great golf from her and I just had to try and stay steady, and the moment on 16 was a key one, definitely." Ciganda sealed the win with a 4-and-2 victory over Jennifer Kupcho, who sank a 93-foot putt to upend Ciganda on Saturday. "I think it's been one of the best teams that we've had in the last few years," Ciganda said. "Everyone is just a unit, a team. That's what Europe is about." The teams were locked in an 8-8 tie before Europe bolted out of the blocks by winning six of Sunday's first eight matches, save for Alison Lee rallying from four down after 11 holes to notch a 1 up win over Esther Henseleit. That represented the biggest comeback in a singles competition in Solheim Cup history. "Huge," Lee said of securing the victory. "I definitely kept an eye on the leaderboard the whole round. I did see a lot of blue up there, but I just did the best I can to change mine red and thankfully I was able to pull it off." --Field Level Media

item.title: Daimler Truck showcases new Fleetboard digital fleet management tools at IAA Transportation 2026
item.description: At IAA Transportation 2026, Daimler Truck outlined a revamped digital fleet-management offering built around a tighter, integrated vehicle-to-portal ecosyst
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At IAA Transportation 2026, Daimler Truck outlined a revamped digital fleet-management offering built around a tighter, integrated vehicle-to-portal ecosystem. Fleetboard will merge 12 products into five packages, spanning fleet operations, analytics, compliance, charging management, Uptime diagnostics. New My TruckPoint Store will sell Fleetboard services online, including standalone Mercedes-Benz Trucks Uptime without a service contract. From January 2027 production, selected Fleetboard services will be bundled for 36 months on most new diesel trucks, electric vehicles. TruckLive will split into Core and Plus from December 2026; Core stays free, Plus free for three years then paid. item.title: Trump reiterates support for united Ireland, says won't talk about Scotland 'yet'
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday reiterated his support for Northern Ireland breaking from the United Kingdom to unify with the Republic of Ireland, but said he would not talk about Scotland becoming independent "yet".
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday reiterated his support for Northern Ireland breaking from the United Kingdom to unify with the Republic of Ireland, but said he would not talk about Scotland becoming independent "yet". Trump surprised officials in Dublin and annoyed pro-British politicians in Northern Ireland and London by enthusiastically[USN:L6N454021 TEXT:" backing"] Irish unity during a visit to Dublin on Saturday, saying he would "love" to see it happen sooner rather than later. "You have Northern Ireland and you have Ireland and it would seem to me that one of the 'naturals' of all time is to put them together," Trump told reporters during a visit to a golf tournament at one of his resorts, doubling down on his initial comments. "You asked about Scotland. That one I won't talk about yet. I'll save that for another day," he added. Scotland, where the Trump family also owns a golf resort, voted against independence from the rest of Britain in 2014. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has [USN:SPN43N00V TEXT:"ruled out"] another vote, as well as a referendum on Northern Ireland leaving the UK. Trump made his comments about Irish unity after a meeting with Micheal Martin, the country's prime minister. In his first comments since Trump's remarks, the Irish premier said the response from some unionist politicians was "an overreaction". "It shouldn't be a surprise. He takes a different sort of perspective on things," Martin told reporters on Sunday after meeting Trump again for lunch at the golf course. Martin said the pair discussed Northern Ireland and its relationship with the Republic of Ireland and that he also went through with the president how the British-run region achieved peace. A 1998 peace agreement ended three decades of violence between Irish nationalists seeking a united Ireland and unionists who wanted Northern Ireland to remain part of the UK. "I support unity, I don't see it happening now. I've been very clear about that," Martin told BBC News in a separate interview. "The chances are if one (vote) was held next week, it would find great difficulty in getting through."

item.title: i-nest capital’s Fund II boosts assets under management to about JPY 6.5 billion

item.content:encoded: i-nest capital completed fundraising for its second fund, lifting assets under management for the vehicle to about JPY 6.5 billion. The fund first closed on Jan. 31, 2025; it has a 10-year term with an extension option of up to two years. Since the first close, the fund has invested in 11 startups as of Sept. 14, 2026. Its first fund was formed in December 2019 with JPY 7.3 billion; it backed 45 companies, generating 14 exits. A three-partner investment committee structure began in June 2026, with Tetsuya Nakajima joining as partner. item.title: Un ataque israelí mata a dos personas en Gaza, informan servicios médicos
item.description: Un ataque aéreo israelí perpetrado el domingo causó la muerte de al menos dos palestinos que viajaban en un vehículo e hirió a otros 13 en la Franja de Gaza, informó personal médico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un ataque aéreo israelí perpetrado el domingo causó la muerte de al menos dos palestinos que viajaban en un vehículo e hirió a otros 13 en la Franja de Gaza, informó personal médico. El ataque, perpetrado en el barrio de Tel Al-Hawa, al oeste de la ciudad de Gaza, dejó el vehículo destrozado, según las imágenes difundidas en las redes sociales. El personal médico local dijo a Reuters que había instado a la población a facilitar información que pudiera ayudar a identificar a las dos personas fallecidas, cuyos cuerpos quedaron desmembrados por la explosión. El Ejército israelí dijo que el ataque tenía como objetivo a dos militantes de Hamás, sin dar más detalles. Un alto el fuego de octubre de 2025, respaldado por Estados Unidos, puso fin a los combates a gran escala en Gaza, pero no ha detenido los ataques israelíes y se ha avanzado muy poco en las medidas encaminadas a una paz permanente. Hamás acusa a Israel de violar el alto el fuego y de socavar los esfuerzos para aplicar el plan más amplio del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, para poner fin al conflicto de Gaza, que incluye la retirada israelí de la Franja y el desarme de Hamás. Israel dice que Hamás ha estado violando el acuerdo. Más de 1.300 palestinos, en su mayoría civiles, han perdido la vida en Gaza desde que entró en vigor el alto el fuego, según las autoridades sanitarias del territorio, mientras que el Ejército israelí dice que han fallecido cuatro soldados israelíes. Hamás no suele revelar información sobre las bajas entre sus combatientes.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon to meet in Rome in October, US State Department official says
item.description: Israel and Lebanon will meet in Rome in October to discuss a U.S.-brokered security agreement intended to ease hostilities along the border, a State Department Official told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israel and Lebanon will meet in Rome in October to discuss a U.S.-brokered security agreement intended to ease hostilities along the border, a State Department Official told Reuters. The continued implementation of the deal “remains the only viable mechanism to restore Lebanon’s sovereignty and Israel’s security,” the official said, adding that the Lebanese and Israeli ambassadors will meet in Washington next week. The seventh round of negotiations in the Italian capital ended in August without a breakthrough on key territorial issues. Hezbollah and Israel returned to war on March 2 amid the wider regional conflict . Israel's military is occupying what it describes as a "buffer zone" about 10 km (6 miles) into Lebanon along the entire length of the Israeli border. Israeli officials say the zone is necessary to protect northern Israeli communities from attacks launched by Hezbollah. More than 4,300 people have been killed by Israeli strikes in Lebanon since March, according to Lebanon's health ministry.

item.title: Carney impulsa la idea de convertir a Canadá en "miembro asociado" de la UE, informa el WSJ
item.description: El primer ministro de Canadá, Mark Carney, desea estrechar las relaciones con la Unión Europea y está estudiando si su país podría convertirse en "miembro asociado" del bloque, informó el domingo el Wall Street Journal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El primer ministro de Canadá, Mark Carney, desea estrechar las relaciones con la Unión Europea y está estudiando si su país podría convertirse en "miembro asociado" del bloque, informó el domingo el Wall Street Journal. La UE, que en el pasado no se ha mostrado flexible en cuanto a las normas de adhesión, está abierta a la idea de conceder a Canadá un estatuto de miembro asociado aún por crear, informó el periódico, citando a funcionarios anónimos tanto de la UE como de Canadá. La embajada de Canadá en Bruselas y los portavoces de la Comisión Europea no respondieron a las respectivas solicitudes de comentarios. La escalada de la guerra comercial de Canadá con Estados Unidos ha añadido urgencia a su giro estratégico hacia otros socios comerciales. Las relaciones entre Ottawa y Washington se han deteriorado considerablemente desde que el presidente Donald Trump regresó a la Casa Blanca el año pasado debido a desacuerdos sobre el comercio y otras cuestiones. La disputa comercial ha dado lugar a aranceles que afectan a decenas de miles de millones de dólares en comercio transfronterizo. Canadá y la UE están debatiendo formas de permitir que los bienes, servicios y trabajadores canadienses que participan en cadenas de suministro estratégicas —como la energía, la inteligencia artificial, la defensa y los minerales críticos— puedan circular libremente, desplazando así de manera efectiva la frontera de la UE, informó el Wall Street Journal. Canadá y la UE también están hablando de tender cables submarinos, construir conjuntamente centros de datos, almacenamiento en la nube y nuevas redes de satélites, así como infraestructuras para transportar energía canadiense a la UE, según el periódico. Carney ha mantenido conversaciones periódicas con varios líderes de la UE, entre los que destaca el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron, sobre la posibilidad de permitir que los canadienses vivan y trabajen en la UE sin necesidad de visado, según el WSJ, que cita a dos funcionarios anónimos familiarizados con el asunto. La oficina de prensa de Macron no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. La oficina de Macron confirmó por separado que se reunirá con Carney el 20 de septiembre en el territorio francés de San Pedro y Miquelón, un archipiélago situado frente a la costa atlántica de Canadá. La reunión supone la primera visita oficial de un primer ministro canadiense al archipiélago y "simboliza la solidez de la relación que une a nuestros dos países", señaló el Elíseo. Sin embargo, cualquier proyecto destinado a estrechar los lazos entre Canadá y la UE probablemente se enfrentará a dificultades, a juzgar por los esfuerzos realizados en el pasado para poner en marcha un acuerdo comercial más modesto, que se ha topado con una feroz oposición dentro de Europa. Más de una década después de que se alcanzó el acuerdo y nueve años desde su entrada en vigor provisional, varios países de la UE aún no lo han ratificado.

item.title: Doblete de Lamine Yamal ayuda al Barcelona a vencer al Levante
item.description: Lamine Yamal marcó dos goles y el Barcelona siguió con su inicio perfecto de temporada tras imponerse por 4-2 al Levante en un reñido partido de LaLiga de fútbol de España disputado el domingo en Valencia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lamine Yamal marcó dos goles y el Barcelona siguió con su inicio perfecto de temporada tras imponerse por 4-2 al Levante en un reñido partido de LaLiga de fútbol de España disputado el domingo en Valencia. Xavi Espart y Karim Adeyemi también marcaron para el Barcelona, que se sitúa en solitario en lo más alto de la clasificación de LaLiga con cinco victorias en cinco partidos, tres puntos por delante del Real Madrid. El Barcelona se adelantó a los cinco minutos, cuando una hábil jugada a un toque terminó con un disparo de Espart, de 19 años, desde el borde del área que, tras un ligero desvío, se coló en la portería, suponiendo su primer gol en la categoría absoluta. El Barcelona siguió dominando la posesión y aumentó su ventaja en el minuto 19. Raphinha controló con maestría un pase en profundidad de Fermín López y encontró a Lamine, desmarcado en el centro del área, para que rematara a puerta sin problemas. El Levante se repuso tras sus dificultades iniciales, ejerciendo a su vez cierta presión, y, a pesar de no crear ocasiones claras, terminó la primera parte con seis disparos a puerta frente a los tres del Barcelona. Gerard Martín, que cojeaba, fue blanco de los delanteros del Levante, y el entrenador del Barcelona, Hansi Flick, lo sustituyó en el descanso por Andreas Christensen. Aissa Mandi cometió un penal a Lamine a los 42 segundos de la reanudación. El extremo culé marcó el lanzamiento desde los 12 pasos para completar su tercer doblete en tres partidos de LaLiga y frustrar la creciente confianza del Levante en que podía remontar el partido. El Levante estuvo a punto de marcar a la hora de juego, cuando Víctor García superó al portero Joan García, pero un bloqueo parcial de Pau Cubarsi y un despeje de Christensen sobre la línea de gol se combinaron para evitar el gol. Un pase erróneo de Espart en el minuto 79 permitió al Levante recortar distancias: el delantero Iván Romero regateó a Joan García antes de enviar el balón al fondo de la red. Nueve minutos más tarde, Roger Brugue se abrió paso entre varias entradas del Barcelona para reducir la diferencia a un solo gol, en un momento en que lo que parecía una cómoda victoria del Barcelona amenazaba con convertirse en una heroica remontada del Levante. Sin embargo, una carrera de Adeyemi y su inteligente remate en el minuto 93 acabaron con las esperanzas de los locales de conseguir el empate. No obstante, la afición local mostró su reconocimiento por el espíritu de lucha demostrado por su equipo, coreando "Levante" mientras el alemán celebraba su gol. A pesar de su tropiezo en los últimos compases, el Barcelona se aseguró su sexta victoria consecutiva en todas las competencias, con la sólida actuación de Rodri en el centro del campo y el incansable esfuerzo del capitán Raphinha como piezas clave de su éxito.

item.title: Lamine Yamal double helps Barcelona beat Levante
item.description: Lamine Yamal scored twice as Barcelona continued their perfect start to the season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lamine Yamal scored twice as Barcelona continued their perfect start to the season with a hard-fought 4-2 LaLiga victory over Levante in Valencia on Sunday. Xavi Espart and Karim Adeyemi were also on target for Barcelona, who are alone at the top of the LaLiga table with five wins from five, three points ahead of Real Madrid. Barcelona went ahead after five minutes when a slick one-touch move ended with 19-year-old Espart firing home from the edge of the box via a slight deflection for his first senior goal. Barcelona continued to dominate possession and doubled their advantage in the 19th minute. Raphinha controlled Fermin Lopez's through ball expertly and picked out an unmarked Lamine in the centre of the box for an easy finish. Levante rallied after their early struggles, applying some pressure of their own, and despite failing to create a clear opening, ended the half with six attempts to Barcelona's three. Gerard Martin, who appeared to be limping, was withdrawn by Barcelona manager Hansi Flick at halftime and replaced by Andreas Christensen. Barcelona struck when Aissa Mandi conceded a penalty for a foul on Lamine 42 seconds after the restart. The winger converted the spot kick to complete his third double in as many LaLiga matches and puncture Levante's growing belief that they could fight their way back into the contest. Levante came close on the hour when Victor Garcia beat goalkeeper Joan Garcia, but a partial block by Pau Cubarsi and Christensen's goal-line clearance combined to keep his effort out. An errant pass from Espart in the 79th minute allowed Levante to pull one back, with forward Ivan Romero rounding Joan Garcia before passing the ball into the net. Nine minutes later, Roger Brugue burst through multiple Barcelona challenges to reduce the deficit to one goal as what looked like a comfortable Barcelona win threatened to turn into a heroic Levante comeback. Yet Adeyemi's mazy run and smart finish in the 93rd minute ended the hosts' hopes of a draw. The home crowd nevertheless showed their appreciation for the fighting spirit shown by their side, chanting 'Levante' as the German celebrated his goal. Despite their late wobble, Barcelona secured a sixth successive win in all competitions, with Rodri's assured midfield display and captain Raphinha's relentless running central to their success. ATLETICO LEAVE IT LATE Atletico Madrid scored three late goals to beat Real Sociedad 3-0, as new signings Alejandro Grimaldo and Jonathan David scored their first goals since joining the club. Both sides struggled to create clear chances until Grimaldo netted an 84th-minute penalty, before David doubled their lead after finding space on the break six minutes later. Giuliano Simeone added a third in the 95th minute to complete the scoring for Atletico, who were without key players Julian Alvarez and Pablo Barrios due to muscle injuries as they returned to winning ways following two consecutive losses. Malaga rescued a 1-1 draw against Celta Vigo, who had dominated the game at Balaidos, while Deportivo A Coruna also drew 1-1 with Getafe after going behind in the second half.

item.content:encoded: Vividthree published audited FY2026 results showing higher revenue of S$ 1.87 million versus unaudited S$ 1.72 million. Gross profit rose to S$ 984,000 from S$ 739,000, reflecting audit-driven revenue recognition adjustments. Net loss attributable to equity holders narrowed to S$ 9.15 million from S$ 9.45 million. Contract liabilities fell to S$ 14,000 from S$ 261,000, linked to the same revenue recognition changes. Derivative financial instrument liability was revised to S$ 1,000 from S$ 23,000 following year-end fair value measurement. item.title: Trump calls $5,000 payouts 'easy' to fit into federal budget
item.description: Congress would have to approve such a payment, House Speaker Mike Johnson said.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Chuck Mikolajczak, Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Sunday the United States can afford his promise to send $5,000 to every U.S. adult should his Republican Party keep control of Congress in this year's elections. "I don't know but it's easy if the Republicans win. $5,000 to all adults in the country and we can easily handle that because we're taking in so much money," Trump told reporters when asked if Congress would need to approve the payments, adding that trillions of dollars were coming into the country. Trump unveiled the idea of $5,000 payouts [USN:L1N451146 TEXT:"during a speech"] at the Republican Party convention last week. Speaking to reporters on Sunday in Ireland, where he was attending a golf tournament at his club in Doonbeg, the president said the U.S. government has the funds to pay for it. But any such payment would need to be approved by Congress, House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Louisiana Republican, said on Sunday. "Of course, the devil's in the details. We have to figure all that out," Johnson told CNN's "State of the Union." Democratic politicians on Sunday morning talk shows panned the idea, with House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries telling ABC's "This Week" that it is not a "serious proposal." U.S. Senator Mallory McMorrow, citing [USN:L1N41O16Y TEXT:"the elimination of some Affordable Care Act subsidies"], cast doubt on whether the promised $5,000 checks would be sent even if Republicans retain control of Congress. "There was an ACA subsidy cancellation," McMorrow, a Michigan Democrat, said on CNN. "I think it was $1,000 we were supposed to get. So if you believe that you're going to get $5,000, I've got a bridge to sell you." U.S. Representative Mike Lawler, a New York Republican in a closely contested race, would not specifically commit to Trump’s $5,000 dividend proposal on Sunday. “I support putting money back in the pockets of hardworking Americans,” he said on ABC’s “This Week,” citing tax cuts in the One Big Beautiful Bill that Republicans passed last year. “But whether you call it a stimulus check or a dividend, the question is, how do you pay for it? That's my focus. We have a $4 trillion debt, and we have to be serious about tackling that.” Lisa Gilbert, co-president of the consumer watchdog Public Citizen, earlier called the move an attempt to buy votes. "This explicit and desperate attempt to buy votes in the November election is a new low. Trump knows he can’t do this, and yet he’s attempting to bribe voters with the false promise of cash to help his party win an election, which is antithetical to every principle of American democracy."

DOONBEG, Ireland: US President Donald Trump on Sunday (Sep 13) likened critics of artificial intelligence to "very negative forces" bringing up scenarios that will not happen, and said he wanted to make sure that the US remains the industry leader. "We're leading China in AI. We're the most sophisticated country in the world, and frankly I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI wins," Trump told reporters at his Ireland golf course, when asked if the AI industry should slow down or be more regulated. "We could put guardrails. We can do this and that. But I think you have a lot of very negative forces that are bringing it up that shouldn't be bringing it up, and they're bringing up things that won't happen." Trump has resisted stirring concerns about AI.

The public debate about AI has heated up in the US after two Anthropic researchers issued warnings that the rapidly progressing technology could lead to the extinction of the human race in the not-too-distant future. In his second term, Trump's administration has largely embraced AI firms. These AI leaders and other technology companies have also supported Trump's initiatives. AI executives have poured money into the midterm campaign ahead of the Nov 3 election that will determine control of Congress. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's super PAC, America PAC, has already spent millions backing Republican candidates and is expected to play a major role in voter turnout efforts this fall. The Pentagon this year warned of risks from Anthropic's model. After the researchers' warnings, some AI CEOs are pushing for slowing advancement of the models. On Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei outlined a three-step framework intended to pace development and create more time to manage its risks. The proposal immediately received endorsements from several other executives at major AI companies, including Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. In an interview that aired Sunday on the CBS program "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan", Amodei said the competition between US and Chinese AI companies was the "toughest dilemma" in trying to establish a "speed limit" on the rate of AI development. "We shouldn't kid ourselves, because the incentives to pull ahead and the military advantage that you get from that are so large that the ability to check that the other side isn't cheating has to be ironclad," he said. "So I think that's going to be the work of years, and honestly, I don't know if it's possible." Jacob Coxon, one of the Anthropic researchers who resigned and then issued the warnings, pushed for the US to work with other countries to ensure pace. "I feel we need international coordination, or else we risk running the same race with China, which could be equally dangerous," Coxon said on NBC's Meet the Press.

Anthropic boss calls for AI slowdown, Altman and Musk agree

item.title: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. (back) out Week 1 amid extension talks
item.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. sat out Week 1 with a back injury amid an "impasse" between the fourth-year defensive back and Pittsburgh's front office in contract extension talks.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. sat out Week 1 with a back injury amid an "impasse" between the fourth-year defensive back and Pittsburgh's front office in contract extension talks. Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Porter and the team have not been able to make progress on a long-term contract extension. ESPN reported Sunday that the Steelers are "listening" to offers for Porter. He was listed as questionable this week. Porter said at the end of training camp that he would consider not suiting up if the two sides didn't make some type of progress toward a new deal. Porter requested a trade and informed the team he is open to moving elsewhere, ESPN reported. "I mean, at the end of the day, it's business, and I know what that is and I got my head straight to understand that," Porter said Friday. Since the end of the 2025 regular season, four cornerbacks have signed contracts averaging at least $30 million annually. Porter, the son of former Steelers outside linebacker Joey Porter Sr., was a second-round pick (No. 32 overall) in the 2023 draft. He has three career interceptions in 47 regular-season games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Atmos Energy forecasts 6%-8% annual EPS, dividend growth through fiscal 2030
item.description: Atmos Energy forecast 6%-8% annual EPS growth through fiscal 2030, supported by a safety-driven, regulated natural gas delivery strategy. Capital plan total
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Atmos Energy forecast 6%-8% annual EPS growth through fiscal 2030, supported by a safety-driven, regulated natural gas delivery strategy. Capital plan totals USD 26 billion through 2030, with more than 85% allocated to safety and reliability projects. Rate-base outlook implies growth from USD 18.8 billion in FY2025 to USD 42 billion by FY2030E. EPS outlook shows USD 8.40-8.50 for FY2025, USD 10.80-11.20 for FY2026E, USD 11.20 by FY2030E. Recovery assumptions include earning on over 90% of annual capex within 6 months, about 99% within 12 months. item.title: Bloque de centroizquierda lidera elección en Suecia, muestran sondeos a boca de urna
item.description: Los partidos de centroizquierda de Suecia, que respaldan a la líder socialdemócrata Magdalena Andersson para el cargo de primera ministra, lideraban las elecciones parlamentarias celebradas el domingo con un 51,3% de los votos, según una encuesta a pie de urna realizada por la cadena SVT.
item.dc:creator: Anna Ringstrom, Simon Johnson
item.content:encoded: Los partidos de centroizquierda de Suecia, que respaldan a la líder socialdemócrata Magdalena Andersson para el cargo de primera ministra, lideraban las elecciones parlamentarias celebradas el domingo con un 51,3% de los votos, según una encuesta a pie de urna realizada por la cadena SVT. Se espera que la Autoridad Electoral sueca dé a conocer los primeros resultados en las próximas horas, tras el cierre de las urnas a las 20.00 hora local (1800 GMT). Otra encuesta realizada el mismo día de las elecciones por la cadena TV4 también situaba al centroizquierda en cabeza. Si los resultados oficiales confirman la ventaja de la centroizquierda, esto frenaría el reciente giro hacia la derecha de Suecia, que la ha alejado de sus tradiciones liberales, en unas elecciones que muchos analistas consideraban un referéndum sobre los Demócratas de Suecia, una formación con raíces en la extrema derecha neonazi. Las encuestas a boca de urna suecas, si bien a menudo son indicativas del resultado final, no siempre han resultado precisas. En 2022, una encuesta a pie de urna pronosticó que el bloque de Andersson se impondría, pero las elecciones las ganó finalmente una coalición de derecha encabezada por Ulf Kristersson, que ahora es primer ministro de Suecia. A medida que se emitían los resultados de las encuestas a boca de urna, estallaron vítores en los mítines electorales de los partidos de centroizquierda, mientras que el resultado fue recibido con silencio entre los Demócratas de Suecia, de extrema derecha, ya que esos sondeos indicaban un revés tras haber aumentado su porcentaje de votos en varias elecciones consecutivas. "Si esto se confirma, Magdalena Andersson se convertirá en la primera ministra de nuestro país", dijo el secretario del Partido Socialdemócrata, Tobias Baudin, a la SVT tras el anuncio de los resultados de la encuesta a boca de urna. La encuesta a pie de urna de la SVT otorgaba al bloque de centroizquierda 183 escaños, por encima de los 175 necesarios para obtener la mayoría, mientras que los partidos de derecha se encaminaban a obtener 166 escaños. "Existe un deseo de cambio", dijo Marie Demker, profesora de ciencias políticas de la Universidad de Gotemburgo. "Cómo se va a llevar a cabo ese cambio con las diferentes líneas rojas que han trazado estos partidos es una preocupación para mañana". Muchos suecos han expresado su recelo ante la apuesta de Kristersson por imponer límites estrictos a la inmigración y consideraron que su promesa preelectoral de incorporar a los Demócratas de Suecia al Gobierno era ir demasiado lejos. "Esto no es lo que esperábamos, pero no son los resultados definitivos, así que habrá que esperar", dijo a TV4 el vicepresidente del partido Demócratas de Suecia, Henrik Vinge. "Es habitual que se produzca un cierto descenso cuando se forma parte de la coalición de gobierno", añadió. Kristersson, que se ha mantenido a la zaga en las encuestas de opinión a lo largo de sus cuatro años en el cargo, había ido recortando distancias en las últimas semanas de campaña, mientras que Andersson y sus socialdemócratas perdían terreno. Los críticos afirman que el Gobierno de Kristersson está socavando las libertades civiles, al tiempo que obliga a los inmigrantes a adaptarse más estrictamente a las normas culturales suecas o a abandonar el país, mediante incentivos y sanciones. El éxito electoral de los Demócratas de Suecia sería bien recibido por los partidos de extrema derecha en auge en Europa, que se vieron reforzados por la victoria del partido antiinmigrante Alternativa para Alemania en unas elecciones regionales celebradas la semana pasada en Alemania. La extrema derecha espera obtener avances en las próximas elecciones en toda Europa, siendo la candidatura de Agrupación Nacional a la presidencia francesa del año que viene, potencialmente, su mayor premio.
